summary: Explore the breathtaking beauty of the Himalayas with guided trekking and camping.
description: Experience the thrill of trekking through the majestic Himalayas. Walk across scenic trails, dense forests, and high-altitude meadows while enjoying stunning mountain views. Camp under the stars and immerse yourself in nature. Ideal for adventure seekers and nature lovers.

name: The Himalayan Adventure
summary: Explore the breathtaking Himalayas with guided trekking and camping.
description: This tour offers an unforgettable journey through the Himalayan mountains with experienced guides, cozy camps, and stunning views.

description: Experience the golden sands of Rajasthan with camel safaris, folk music, and desert camping.

description: Enjoy nightlife, beach parties, water sports, and delicious seafood in Goa.

description: Visit Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam with scenic views, houseboats, and snow activities.

name: Uttarakhand Nature Retreat

description: Enjoy fresh mountain air, scenic views, and peaceful surroundings in Uttarakhand.

description: Ride through the highest motorable roads, explore monasteries, and enjoy breathtaking landscapes.

name: Delhi City Explorer
description: Visit monuments, markets, and experience the vibrant culture of Delhi.

name: Lakshadweep Island Tour
description: Enjoy crystal clear waters, coral reefs, and peaceful island life in Lakshadweep.
